summary: Microbot Medical Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) on May 14, 2026, announcing revenue from the limited market release of its LIBERTY Endovascular Robotic System in Q1 2026 and that a transition to full market release has boosted Q2 2026 revenue above Q1 levels, with accelerating utilization and adoption across multiple territories. The filing is a routine business update with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event. It does not involve any deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The press release is furnished and not deemed filed for Section 18 purposes. Watch for future revenue trends or partnership announcements, but no event-driven arbitrage angle exists.
